text:
Maria (PM): heads up — support intake shows 3 separate asks that look functionally identical: Acme (INC-4452), BetaCorp (CRM-2321), and an AE escalation. All are asking for per-tenant rate limits exposed via API + console.
Raj (Support): +1, filed them as separate tickets but flagged as potential dupes. Attached logs and a short customer note for each.
Alejandra (Sales): Acme is an enterprise trial, asked for timeline last week. They said they need enforcement + visibility, not just docs.
Maria (PM): proposal: merge into one canonical backlog item "tenant-rate-limits" with sub-requests for enforcement, metrics, and UI. Tag all tickets as duplicates and link. Thoughts?
Tom (Eng): sounds right. Need to confirm enforcement semantics: per-tenant TPS vs per-API-key. Also quota backend changes could be nontrivial.
Kelsey (Solutions): customers actually want two things: (1) hard limits (reject on exceed) and (2) usage dashboard with breakdown by tenant/route. Both important for enterprise.
Raj (Support): can confirm, INC-4452 asked for hard limits first, BetaCorp mostly wants visibility. I'll add notes.
Maria (PM): quick triage checklist:
- Owner: assign to eng-ops (Tom to confirm)
- Priority: propose P2 but upgrade if Sales confirms contract risk
- Acceptance: API to set/get limits, enforcement in gateway, console view + audit logs
- Rollout: opt-in per-tenant initially
Please add `customer_request:tenant-rate-limits` tag and `duplicate-of:1789999999` on all intake tickets.
Tom (Eng): assigning to eng-ops squad. Could we split into two PRs: backend enforcement + console? That'll help parallelize.
Alejandra (Sales): if we can promise a pilot (Acme) within 8 weeks, they'll sign the addendum. Noting contract timeline.
Maria (PM): noted. I'll set target milestone = Q2-sprint-3 for pilot. If Sales confirms high risk, we'll revisit priority.
Kelsey (Solutions): sample acceptance test idea: create tenant, set limit X, send X+N requests, verify 429s and metrics labeled with tenant id.
triage-bot: auto-tagging applied: `needs-repro`, `enterprise-impact` :eyes:
Raj (Support): I've updated INC-4452, CRM-2321, and AE ticket with the `duplicate-of:1789999999` link and short summary for customers.
Maria (PM): ok next actions:
- Tom: scope split & initial estimate (by EOD tomorrow)
- Raj: confirm customer asks mapped to enforcement vs metrics
- Alejandra: confirm Acme timeline and whether pilot requires NDA
I'll post status back to requesters: "Acknowledged — merged into canonical request, owner assigned, triage in progress. Targeting pilot milestone; will update in 2w." :thumbsup:
Alejandra (Sales): thanks, that messaging works.
Tom (Eng): will post a short design doc and cost/infra notes in #eng-platform and link here.
Maria (PM): perfect. closing the loop with Sales and Support; will add to backlog with the tags and PRIO=P2. If anyone hears a change in contract urgency raise here.
Kelsey (Solutions): :+1: can prepare a short migration/implementation note for customer-facing comms once we have design.
Maria (PM): thanks everyone — I'll update the thread when estimates and doc are in.
